title: fix(plugin-chatbot): render an answer's text and charts in stream order (objectui#13492)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D1ujqNbMkVbXgPHgdDMe18r)_

Fixes #13492

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

An assistant answer now renders its text and its charts in the order the stream produced them. A chart the model drew before writing its analysis shows first, so an open-ended analysis in the console's assistant panel puts its chart on the first screen (the acceptance objectstack-ai/cloud#3072 sets). Before, `mapMessages` joined every text part into one `content` and lifted every `data-chart` part into one trailing `charts[]`, and `ChatbotEnhanced` rendered the whole text first, so the chart always landed below every paragraph.

- **`mapMessages.ts`:** `extractCharts` now records, on each chart, where it arrived among the text parts: `textOffset` = the length of the text that `extractText` joined before it. Tool, step and reasoning parts add nothing. Only when `content` IS that join; a legacy string `content` is not built from the parts, so its charts carry no offset.
- **`ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`:** a new optional `ChatChart.textOffset`. `layoutAnswer` splits `content` at the offsets into text runs and chart runs; each text run renders through its own `MessageResponse` (so long-answer folding and record links work in every run), and each chart run through the same chart markup as before, now in `AnswerCharts`. The streaming caret rides the last text run, where it sat before. Charts render in the same tree position whether or not prose has arrived, so a chart drawn before the first word keeps its mounted node when the text streams in.
- **Backward-compatible:** `content` and `charts` keep their shape. A chart with no `textOffset` (a host-built message, the legacy string-content shape) or one past the end of the text trails all of it, which is exactly the old layout; a message with no charts renders the same DOM as before. `textOffset` is a placement key and never reaches the chart schema handed to `SchemaRenderer`.

## The card's acceptance, item by item

| Acceptance | Pinned by |
|---|---|
| parts `data-chart`, `text`: the chart renders before the text | `data-chart then text: the chart renders before the analysis` |
| parts `text`, `data-chart`, `text`: the three in that order | `text, data-chart, text: the three render in that order` |
| a re-hydrated stored message keeps the order | `useObjectChat.chartOrderRehydrate-13492.test.tsx` (API mode, stored message with `parts` through the hook and into the bubble) and `re-mapping a restored message (same parts) yields the same placement` |
| long-answer folding (objectui#13032) does not regress | `objectui#13032 does not regress: the long analysis after a chart still folds once the stream ends`, plus the unchanged `chatAnswerLayout-13032.test.tsx` |
| record links (objectui#13037) do not regress | `objectui#13037 does not regress: a record link in the text after a chart opens through the host opener`, plus the unchanged `chatRecordLink-13037.test.tsx` |
| staging re-test with 「帮我分析一下客户」 | **NOT MEASURED**: staging reaches this through cloud's objectui pin; re-run after the pin moves past this merge |

New files: `mapMessages.chartOrder-13492.test.ts` (6 tests), `ChatbotEnhanced.chartOrder-13492.test.tsx` (7, one a CONTROL for the old layout), `useObjectChat.chartOrderRehydrate-13492.test.tsx` (2). `mapMessages.test.ts` gains the `textOffset` in the one test that pins a chart's exact shape.

## Verification (local, head `cb0af96`)

All runs from the repo root under the shared verify lock.

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-chatbot/`: **Test Files 82 passed (82), Tests 787 passed (787)**.
- The 54 test files in `packages/app-shell/src` and `apps/console/src` that import `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` (resolved to its `src` by the root config's alias): **Test Files 54 passed (54), Tests 582 passed (582)**.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` (builds the dependency closure, then `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0 after one fix to the new re-hydrate test (it now hands the hook's messages through `toRuntimeMessages`, as hosts do).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the six touched source and test files: 0 errors; the 11 warnings are all on lines this PR does not touch.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: pass. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations. `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:ui-root-lookups`, `check:unreferenced-sources`: all exit 0.
- **Reverse verification**, both through `ablation-replace.mjs` with the fix committed and restore proven (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - renderer: `layoutAnswer` ignores `textOffset` (every chart trails the text) ⇒ 6 of the 9 render and re-hydrate tests turn red; the record-link test, the old-layout CONTROL and the mapper tests stay green, as they should.
  - mapper: the `textOffset` spread deleted ⇒ 13 tests red across the four files, including the existing exact-shape test; the legacy no-offset test stays green.
- NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI: the sharded full `pnpm test`, repo-wide `pnpm lint`, builds and the remaining `check:*` gates.

## Acceptance notes

- **No reload path in this repository restores a chart today, so on reload the chart is missing, not misplaced.** The server keeps a conversation as Vercel `ModelMessage`s (`IAIConversationService.addMessage` in `@objectstack/spec`'s `contracts/ai-service.ts`), which have no data parts. On the way back, app-shell's `hydratedMessagesToChatMessages` builds `content` and tool invocations only, and `sanitizeChatMessagesForCache` writes text and tool parts only. Read from code, not measured on staging; outside this card's file surface (`packages/plugin-chatbot/src/**`). A stored message that does carry its `data-chart` parts keeps its order (pinned above). Whether cloud's `visualize_data` result carries enough to re-derive the chart on reload is a cloud-side reading this session cannot reach.
- In an answer that interleaves text and charts, each text run folds on its own (a run taller than two viewport heights folds; a short intro above the chart does not). An answer with no chart, or with its charts after all the text, is one run and folds exactly as before.
- Docs: neither `packages/plugin-chatbot/README.md` nor `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx` describes where charts render, so nothing there went stale; `textOffset` is documented on the `ChatChart` type.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
